caption: The drawing depicts a brown eagle with wings spread, positioned atop a blue spherical form. The eagle is facing to the left and holds a shield with its left claw. The shield is decorated with a blue top section featuring three white stars, and vertical red and white stripes below. The background behind the eagle consists of a light blue arc, which contains symmetrical golden-brown leafy scroll motifs on either side of the eagle, extending to the edges of the arc. The composition is centered horizontally on a plain, unadorned light background.
title: Stern Piece
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
